description: The top-level keys each HyperSVG 2.0 document kind allows, so a checker can report unknown keys (E-KEY-UNKNOWN) and missing keys (E-KEY-REQUIRED). Built from the kinds of 2.3, the key table of 4.2 and the section that defines each kind. A key is allowed in a kind only if it is listed under that kind; every kind allows the header keys format, kind, id and $schema (2.2). type is a short JSON-Schema-like type ("string|object" means either; "integer" may carry minimum); $ref:<name> names the structure that the section in section defines. owner is core, or the capability whose manifest (capabilities/<name>.json) owns the key: a capability key is allowed only in a document whose needs names that capability, or that belongs to an experience or kit whose needs does (2.1). required is true where the spec says so or makes it plain; requiredWhen gives a condition for a conditional requirement. requireOneOf lists key groups of which at least one key must be present (4.2). idFromFile follows 2.2: folder = the id is the name of the folder whose main file this is; flat-file = the id is the base name of the file; folder-or-flat-file = either layout is used; entry-experience = a package takes its entry experience id; none = the id need not match a file name. kit experience gives the keys an experience may carry when it pins a kit (4.2, 4.9). headerKind says which kind value the header carries when it is not the entry name. Keys inside values (for example inputs.*.live of live-data, addons.physics of physics, uses[].declared of shell) belong to the capability manifests and are not document keys. The capabilities ai, fit, live-data, motion, effects, snapshot and the module chess own no top-level document key.
structuresNote: structures gives each $ref:<name> its JSON type (string|object means a short string form or the full object) and the section that defines its inside. The inside is defined by that section; a capability manifest gives its own keys a closed grammar.

experience.description: Scenes linked in a story graph. With a kit pin it is a kit experience.

kit experience.note: Drawing, layouts and the behaviour keys are not experience keys at all. 4.9 says a kit experience carries the keys 4.2 lists for kit experiences and nothing else, so an experience key not in allowed is refused in a kit experience.

story.note: every experience that lists no experiences has a story; a one-scene experience lists that scene in ends (3.1)

kit.note: the pin {"id", "version", "digest"?}; its presence makes the experience a kit experience

with.note: kit experience only: values for the kit inputs (4.8)

limits.note: capacity limits this experience needs above the format values; a host admits it only if its profile allows them

kit.description: A versioned set of definitions, rule packs, themes and resources.

blocks.note: definition id to file; components, compounds, scenes, shells

inputs.note: the kit own content fields and knobs

addons.note: the settings of built-in capabilities the kit gives every experience that uses it (rich-text styles); they join the experience document, which may not hold its own

aliases.note: old definition id to current definition id

samples.note: sample kit experience id to file; a template kit needs one

catalogue.note: the kit catalogue file (catalogue.json): item id to {type, title, tags, line, preview, and one of block, resource, theme, preset, rulePack}; checked by the kits family (E-CATALOGUE)

about.note: about.version is required for a rule pack (10.10)

inputs.note: knobs the rules read by name

authoringOnly.note: true: used only while making, left out of packages

receipt.description: The record of one check, fit, play test, review, export or change run. Carries no about (2.5). Which run holds which key is the "Held by" table of A8.1.

run.note: check, fit, play-test, review, export or change

subject.note: a typed reference such as scene:summer-sale, document:harbour-ad or play-test:<id>

digest.note: for an export, the package digest (A10.1); for a refused change, equal to previous (9.10)

profile.note: any run: the host profile id

steps.note: held by fit runs (spacing and give-way steps) and by play-test runs (the steps run)

rules.note: every run: rule results rule, result, proof, detail?, witness?

kit.note: any run: the kit version a re-check used; its shape is not given

previous.note: held by change runs: the digest before the change

by.note: held by change runs: source, right, who

changes.note: held by change runs: address, old, new

errors.note: held by change runs with status fail: diagnostics

adapter.note: held by export runs: adapter id and version; its shape is not given

output.note: held by export runs: the output digest

bytes.note: held by export runs: the actual size

notCarried.note: held by export runs: features with reasons

change.description: One change request of the changes protocol; a message, not a file. Carries no about.

expected.note: edit: a digest (a string), required; play: the store revision, an integer, optional

by.note: source, right, who; filled by whoever authenticated the source, so the requester need not supply it

play-test.description: A scripted play test. Carries no about (2.5).

start.note: {scene, fixtures}; the start scene when scene is null or start is absent

rules.note: rule addresses <pack or block id>/<rule id>

package.description: One experience with everything it needs.

about.note: about.title, about.version and about.trust.digest are required for a package (10.10)

experience.note: path of the experience document that plays first

needs.note: the union of all needs; recomputed and checked (E-PACKAGE-DESCRIPTOR)

grants.note: the grants the experience asks for: as written, with openUrl and storage requested from use (D31.4); the host decides

inputs.note: a list of {address, kind, type, bounds, editableBy}, not the map of 5.3; [] when none

members.note: path to sha256 digest, for every file except package.json

findings.note: test builds only: the accepted checker errors, each {code, file, path}; a host refuses the package

host-profile.description: What one host runs and grants, and its budgets: one document per host. Carries no about (2.5).

capabilities.note: the capabilities this host runs, by name; absent: every capability the player has. A package that needs another is refused at mount (E-HOST-RUNS)

grants.note: in the shape of 10.5; anything not listed is denied

limits.note: how far this host lets content raise capacity limits; anything not listed stays at the format value

options.note: default options for the axes whose selector is host: axis id to option

requireSignature.note: whether a package must carry a valid signature (A9.3)

requireSignedReviews.note: whether admission uses signed reviews only (A9.3); default false

keys.note: keys the host trusts: a list of {id, by, alg, publicKey}; a signature's key names an id (A9.3)

retention.note: days to keep stored data (an integer, 1 or more; E-RANGE); data whose writtenAt is more days before the host's now is dropped before restore; absent means until cleared

capability.description: A capability manifest (a module such as chess uses the same keys).

grammar.note: closed schemas by category; each export of a module may set budgetMs (1..1000) and budgetSteps (integer 1..10,000,000, default 10,000,000), 10.7

grants.note: grant kind names the capability code may use
